    Profile

    Kasumi is a female high school student hailing from another world. She was summoned to Babel for being the Phantom Soldier who could seal away the Darkness. Despite being endowed with incredibly strong powers of resonance, she lived with her emotions locked inside her heart. Thoughtful and kind towards others, she is capable of sympathizing with almost anyone.

    Origin: Earth
    Gender: Female
    Height: 158cm
    Weight: 47kg
    Birthday: Jan 15
    Blood Type: Type O
    Zodiac: Capricorn
    Likes: Theater
    Hobbies: Cooking
    Illust: RINZO
    CV: 水瀬いのり
